input.summary: Verified the UCL Computer Science MSc admissions deadlines and separated programme-listed funding from central UCL funding. All identified 2026 deadlines are past as of August 8, 2026.

sections.title: Programme application deadline
sections.body: For 2026/27 entry, the official UCL Computer Science MSc page lists March 27, 2026 for applicants requiring a UK visa, and August 28, 2026 at 10:00 UK time for applicants who do not require a visa. The applicant is a Nigerian resident, so the visa-required route is the relevant one unless they have another basis for not requiring a visa. The March 27 deadline has passed. The page does not publish a timezone for the March 27 deadline; the August 28 deadline is explicitly UK time.

sections.title: Distinct UCL-wide funding deadlines
sections.body: Separately from the programme page: UCL International Masters Awards — May 7, 2026 at 17:00 BST; UCL Global Masters Scholarship — May 7, 2026 at 17:00 BST, up to £15,000; UCL-GREAT Scholarship 2026 for Nigeria — May 7, 2026 at 17:00 BST, £10,000; UCL Master’s Bursary — June 25, 2026 at 17:00 BST, Home-fee applicants only and therefore not supported by the current applicant facts. These deadlines have passed.

sections.title: Programme-specific funding and verification limits
sections.body: The Computer Science MSc page lists the UCL East London Scholarship with a June 25, 2026 deadline, but its published eligibility/programme scope does not establish applicability to this overseas Computer Science MSc applicant. No separate overseas Computer Science MSc-specific funding deadline was verified on the programme page; UCL directs applicants to central and department funding pages. Award eligibility involving household income, fee status, or an offer remains subject to UCL assessment.

follow_ups: If this is intended for a later intake, verify the next cycle’s official Computer Science MSc and UCL funding pages when published.
